threads.body: This assertion now applies the `test-peer-service` default to every subclass, but the Ktor 2.0 and 3.0 library suites still inherit that default even though `HttpClientInstrumentationExtension.forLibrary()` does not configure the javaagent peer-service mapping. Add `setExpectedServicePeerName { null }` to both Ktor library test configurations, as done for the other library suites; otherwise these suites contradict the PR's library expectation and fail when this shared assertion runs.

replies.body: No longer relevant after the follow-up refactor. The shared assertion now derives the expectation from `testing.isJavaagent()`, so Ktor library tests inherit `false` from the library runner and explicitly require the peer-service attribute to be absent. The per-test `setExpectedServicePeerName` option has been removed entirely.
